name: Minnesota

default_limits.basis: Minn. Stat. § 169.14 subd. 2: 30 urban district; 55 elsewhere; 65 noninterstate expressways/freeways; 70 rural interstate, 65 interstate in urbanized areas; 10 in alleys; 25 residential roadway / 35 rural residential district only if adopted by road authority.

fine.notes: Statewide Payables List (eff. 1/1/2025). 20+ over: fine shown includes the extra speeding surcharge equal to the base fine (§ 169.14 subd. 2(d)). Petty misdemeanor max fine $300 (§ 169.89).

court_costs.notes: $75 state surcharge on every conviction, plus a county law library fee (about $0-$15, varies by county).

points.notes: No point system. Convictions go on record (some low-level 55/60 zone tickets are not recorded). 3 petty violations in 12 months can be charged as a misdemeanor.

zones.work_zone: $300 fine + $75 surcharge when workers present (§ 169.14 subds. 5d, 6a); 45 mph limit on 50+ mph roads when a lane is closed and workers present.
zones.school_zone: Extra surcharge equal to the fine, minimum $25 (§ 169.14 subd. 5a).

court.reason: 20+ over: fine doubled by surcharge. Over 100 mph: 6-month license revocation.

arrest.offense: Reckless driving (§ 169.13) or speeding that endangers persons/property (§ 169.89 subd. 1) - misdemeanor
arrest.license: Over 100 mph: license revoked 6 months (§ 169.14 subd. 1a, § 171.17)

trucks.notes: § 169.14 sets no separate truck speed limits.

notes: No speed number makes speeding criminal; misdemeanor only if reckless/endangering (payables list tells officers to note endangerment at 31+ over). Misdemeanor penalty (90 days/$1,000) taken from House Research summary, not § 609.03 directly. 2026 payables list not found; 2025 used. Speed cameras (pilot to 8/1/2029): $40, $80 if 20+ over.
